name: Yaourt phô mai
summary: Yaourt phô mai beside the bánh căn, and a yaourt beside the morning xíu mại bowls.
origin: Yaourt phô mai at the bánh căn doors, and a yaourt beside bánh mì xíu mại.
howToEat: Have it next to a hot bowl or after the cakes.
where: Cây Bơ at 56 Tăng Bạt Hổ, Lệ at 27/44 Yersin, and the door at 7 Tăng Bạt Hổ. The xíu mại counters at 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật also sell a yaourt.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 5,000 VND for yaourt and does not say phô mai. The bánh căn listings name yaourt phô mai and do not print that 5,000 VND figure. A single price is Check on arrival.
